columns.dataset_version: Shared release identifier; identical on every row.
columns.record_id: Globally unique stable identity; original master IDs are preserved.
columns.record_type: What the row represents: exercise, food, reference passage, resource, rule, profile, or original source-table type.
columns.record_stage: Original source, current prepared record, historical unlinked source, indexed reference, or development draft.
columns.title: Human-readable name or existing identity.
columns.text: Convenience text. For classifier development this is the exact saved canonical classifier_text. For RAG it is the exact indexed core. Protected/excluded exercise text is blank.
columns.source_dataset: Which source/preparation collection owns this row.
columns.source_record_id: Original record ID in the owning collection.
columns.source_file: Owning file in the earlier team source package, or raw USDA ZIP.
columns.source_row: One-based CSV/JSONL data-row position where directly bound; blank for keyed objects or nested USDA ZIP records. source_record_id is the authoritative identity.
columns.source_sha256: SHA-256 of the owning source file. Nested archive member hashes are in metadata.
columns.source_url: Recorded public locator where available; not a fresh publisher verification.
columns.split: Frozen classifier membership: train, validation, test, excluded; blank for other row types.
columns.target_label: Frozen supervised classifier target where eligible. Never a model feature.
columns.class_index: Frozen zero-based classifier class index; 0 is valid.
columns.classifier_use: training, validation, reserved_test, excluded, or not_classifier_input.
columns.retrieval_use: Only indexed_reference identifies the existing eleven-core corpus. Other records are not automatically indexed.
columns.planner_status: Recorded prototype adoption/readiness; never proof activation or validators executed.
columns.food_lookup_use: Distinguishes selected100 SR Legacy lookup foods from unselected source foods and the earlier Foundation table.
columns.review_status: Saved scoped source/review disposition; consolidation creates no new review.
columns.protection_status: Protects all439 rows in held-out exercise groups, including one excluded sibling.
columns.is_synthetic: true for fictional profile rows; no real athlete outcomes are introduced.
columns.data_json: Lossless nested source fields, source versions/history and route-specific details. Includes complete reference delivery bundles; shared definitions and policies are in dataset_manifest.json.

batch_contract.padding: right to longest retained sequence in current batch
batch_contract.reference_pooling_scope: Artificial NumPy arithmetic, not a neural model or PyTorch gradient/embedding integration check
batch_contract.representation: Python integer lists and Boolean masks; tensor conversion in Step 20

diagnostic_definitions.raw_token_vocabulary_coverage: raw ordinary tokens mapping to retained vocabulary / raw token positions; empty fallback excluded
diagnostic_definitions.removed_position_rate: removed positions / all effective positions before truncation
diagnostic_definitions.truncated_record_rate: rows losing effective positions / all rows in the declared split or class
diagnostic_definitions.unknown_rate_effective_before: UNK positions / effective positions before truncation, including fallback
diagnostic_definitions.unknown_rate_retained: retained UNK positions / retained positions, including fallback

input.canonical_validity: Actual canonical exercise input must be nonblank. Generic normalization/tokenization can represent empty strings, but prepare_canonical_text and the raw vectorizer tokenizer reject empty/whitespace canonical input.
input.missing_descriptions: Preserve absence and name-only inputs; never coerce missing values to strings or generate descriptions.

policy.module_status: Complete importable preprocessing module saved and read back in Step 18.

neural_sequence_policy.length_basis: full token lengths after nonempty-token fallback, before truncation
neural_sequence_policy.mask: Boolean non-PAD positions; UNK counts as an input position
neural_sequence_policy.padding: right-pad each batch to its longest retained sequence within the saved limit
neural_sequence_policy.target_class_zero: valid label index; separate from token PAD ID zero

neural_vocabulary_policy.frequency_basis: total token occurrences over full untruncated training text

ordered_operations: collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space
